methods.replicates: ap.bootstrap_ci (cluster bootstrap over the grouping; the same draws for every checkpoint: paired)
methods.intervals: ap.interval_methods: percentile, basic, BCa (jackknife over the same units), bias = replicate mean - point
methods.differences: per-replicate A - B; jackknife of the difference = difference of the jackknife values; p_le_0 = share of replicates <= 0
methods.mAP50_classes: mean AP50 over the classes with >= 20 ground-truth instances in the set
methods.operating point: micro P / R / F1, pipeline detections (best-class NMS, conf > 0.3), IoU 0.5
